extracted.name: Raspberry kefir overnight oats
extracted.description: Wake up to these healthy, gut-friendly breakfast oats. Prep in just 10 minutes the night before, then top with a layer of berries, dark chocolate and seeds
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp shelled hemp seeds plus 2 tsp to serve
instruction_lines: Tip the oats, 1 tbsp of the hemp seeds and the chia seeds into a bowl, then mix well. Stir in the kefir yogurt and milk. Cover and chill overnight. The mixture will thicken overnight as it soaks.
The next morning, spoon into two glass tumblers and top with the raspberries, remaining hemp seeds, the pumpkin seeds and chocolate.
